svg.title: The 24-hour soak
svg.desc: The soak's 24 hours: in panel a, the share of each hour's replies over the SLO of 1,976 ms against the requirement of at most 5%, 74 of 5,058 replies (1.5%) over the day, at most 14 of 254 (5.5%) in hour 4; in panel b, the agents' tokens a second, 3,529 over the day, 9,300 in hour 0 and 582 to 5,402 in each hour after.
svg.text: (a) Share of each hour's replies over the SLO
